headline: 260 photos uploaded in 10 minutes by Collector & District Magistrate
reasons: 260 different photos for 145 different works were uploaded by Collector & District Magistrate within 10 minutes, from 2026-05-29 04:40:27 to 2026-05-29 04:50:13.
That is about one work every 4 seconds on average.
The works are in 7 villages: Adejhar, Awari, Bhaisbor, Chikhali, Danitola, Talgaon, Tekapar.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
